subject: Request: GVBank SOC2 personnel evidence (training, BG checks, leavers)
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@greenvalley.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: GVBank SOC2 personnel evidence (training, BG checks, leavers)

Jordan / Kimberly —

GreenValley is starting our SOC2 readiness work for a customer-facing audit and we need to collect evidence for personnel controls covering onboarding, training, background checks, and offboarding. Can you provide the following items by EOD Friday, 2027-06-18?

1) Training completion roster (for security awareness and data handling) covering Jan 2025 — May 2027. CSV preferred.
2) Redacted background-check confirmations (vendor reports are sensitive) — we only need the attestations (name, hire date, check completed date, vendor, and pass/flag). If you require a signed authorization to deliver redacted copies, please flag and send DocuSign link.
3) Leaver/deprovisioning log for the last 36 months (user id, termination date, deprovision date, role).
4) Any documented offboarding checklist templates used by HR.

We will use a sample-based approach; if you prefer to deliver a full compressed package, please include a manifest and indicate redaction strategy. If you have any questions about acceptable redaction, see our guidance here: https://greenvalley-secure.example.com/redaction-guidance (internal).

Thanks — appreciate a short confirmation and ETA.

— Raj
Raj Patel
Senior Auditor, InfoSec Programs
GreenValley Bank

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@greenvalley.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: GVBank SOC2 personnel evidence (training, BG checks, leavers)

Raj — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what you need: 

• For the background checks, do you want the vendor report filenames removed entirely, or replaced with a vendor identifier only?
• For the leaver log, is a CSV export from our identity provider sufficient, or do you need HR system change timestamps as well?

Planned owner assignments on our side: Kimberly will pull the training roster and offboarding templates; Karthik will prepare the redacted background attestations and the leaver/deprovisioning export.

We can aim to deliver a compressed bundle (manifest + sample redactions) by 2027-06-17 and a full sample set (per your sampling plan) by 2027-06-21. If that works, we'll proceed and send the DocuSign authorization if needed.

Looping in Karthik and Kimberly to confirm ETA.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Compliance Segment
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: GVBank SOC2 personnel evidence (training, BG checks, leavers)

Jordan / Kim — prepping the bundle now. Notes and constraints: 

• Background checks: Our vendor (ClearHire Solutions) provides full reports; for audit deliveries we supply an attest-only CSV that includes: full_name, hire_date, check_completed_date, vendor (ClearHire), and status (Clear/Flagged). We do not hand over raw vendor PDFs without a signed NDA + auditor authorization.

• Vendor identifier policy: we can either leave vendor column as "ClearHire" or replace with a tokenized identifier (e.g., VENDOR-CH-01) if GreenValley prefers vendor obfuscation. Which do you want?

• Leaver log: Identity provider CSV will include user_id, last_active, last_login, deprovision_date. HR system timestamps (termination_request_date, HR_processed_date) are in a separate HR export; we can include both as separate sheets in the workbook.

Attachments I will stage in Drive for delivery (see links below) and will attach a compressed ZIP to the final email:
- training_completion_roster_2026.csv (attachment_stub) — contains employee_id, name, role, training_module, completion_date, score
- redacted_bg_checks_2026.zip (attachment_stub) — attest-only CSV + redaction manifest
- leaver_log_2024-2027.xlsx (attachment_stub) — id/termination/deprovision sheets

DocuSign: We do require a short auditor authorization form for delivery of attestations. I will send a DocuSign link unless GreenValley confirms vendor identifiers are sufficient (then we can send without additional signatures).

ETA: I can have the drive folder ready and a sample redaction by EOD 2027-06-16. Full manifest and zipped sample by 2027-06-17.

Karthik Iyer
Compliance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3GVBankEvidence
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@greenvalley.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: GVBank SOC2 personnel evidence (training, BG checks, leavers)

Thank you — this plan looks good. A couple quick decisions: 

1) Vendor column may remain as "ClearHire"; no need to obfuscate.
2) We accept the attest-only CSV for background checks. Please include a redaction manifest describing what was removed.
3) DocuSign: please go ahead and send the short auditor authorization for our records.

Delivery deadline for the sample bundle is confirmed as 2027-06-17. We'll review the sample and send a sampling plan for full delivery if everything looks in scope.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll be in touch after the sample review.

— Raj
Raj Patel
Senior Auditor, InfoSec Programs
GreenValley Bank
